title: Order
description: A request to generate one image.

$schema.description: Schema reference so editors can validate and complete the file.

key.description: Order key; slash-separated safe segments, no leading slash and no .. segments.

profile.description: Name of the project profile to use.

negative.description: Negative prompt: what the image must not show. Optional; an empty one is the same as none. Passed to sd-cli as --negative-prompt.

references.description: Reference image paths, relative to the project root.

initImage.description: Initial image for img2img, relative to the project root.

strength.description: How far img2img departs from initImage (0 to 1); needs initImage.

params.description: Per-order overrides of the profile sampling settings.

text.description: Texts for the composition template, by field name (the profile's compose.fields); up to 200 characters, no control characters or lone surrogates.

draft.description: Generate drafts (D32): the profile draft settings, or half size and 8 steps.

mode.description: brand: the prompt is built from the project's brand sheet (needs piece and subject; the prompt is not sent). free (or absent): the prompt is the order's own.

piece.description: Brand mode: the piece type of the sheet; it sets the profile and the default seed, count and model.

subject.description: Brand mode: what the image shows (the first sentence of the assembled prompt).

cleanZone.description: Brand mode: the clean zone sentence, if any.

sheetVersion.description: Stored by the generator in brand mode: the version of the sheet that built the prompt. Not for clients to set.

batches.description: Stored by the generator: one record per enqueue of attempts (a brand one, or more than one attempt). Not for clients to set.

id.description: Id of the batch's first queue entry.

warnings.description: The lint checks with status warn.

failed.description: The batch was counted as a failure ("Ninguno vale", or every attempt discarded).

extended.description: It is the batch an extension of the troubleshooting block allowed.

failures.description: Stored by the generator in brand orders: the failure counter. Not for clients to set; an order without it has no failures.

count.description: Failed batches in a row; an attempt of 5 or more, a new subject or a troubleshooting row put it back to zero.

limit.description: At this count the order is in troubleshooting (3 unless brand.failureLimit says otherwise).

troubleshooting.description: Stored by the generator in brand orders: the troubleshooting rows of the order and the one-more-batch extensions. Not for clients to set.

extendPending.description: One more batch was allowed and is not used yet.

modeChanges.description: Stored by the generator: each switch of the order's mode (brand to free).

failReason.description: Why a batch or an attempt failed: a trait of the sheet (or other, which needs text).

profileName.description: Profile name: lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter, no hyphens (the profile is what follows the last hyphen in delivered file names).

relativePath.description: Relative path that cannot be absolute, start with ~, contain .. segments, backslashes or control characters.

fieldName.description: Name of a text field of the composition template ({{name}}): starts with a lowercase letter, letters and digits only; "logo" is reserved.
